mechanisms.mechanism_statement: A localized reactive lime reservoir drives functional recovery after damage.
mechanisms.support_region: Modern lime-pozzolan mortar with identified lime-rich inclusions; transfer is unresolved.
mechanisms.prior_basis: Offline mechanism fixture derived from the problem context; not established evidence.
predicted_observations: Recovery should track the presence and exposure of reactive lime-rich regions.
falsifiers: Matched specimens without reactive lime-rich regions recover identically under the same exposure.

mechanisms.mechanism_statement: Observed recovery is dominated by non-chemical physical crack closure.

mechanisms.prior_basis: Offline mechanism fixture derived from the problem context; not established evidence.
predicted_observations: Closure can occur without a matching improvement in functional water transport.
falsifiers: Functional recovery consistently exceeds closure-only controls under matched conditions.
